name: app-onboarding-question-screen-with-gradient-arc
title: Onboarding Question with Warm Gradient Arc
whatItIs: A phone with a periwinkle onboarding screen asking about the user's closest family, a step indicator, a large blurred blue-to-orange arc at the bottom and two pill buttons, Write and a blue voice button.
whatItMeans: The soft colour arc gives a warm human feel to a personal question, and two clear input choices reduce friction.
techniques: Blurred blue-to-orange arc as a visual anchor
Step dots with a long active bar
White and blue pill pair for input modes

vocabulary.definition: Dots or bars showing progress through a flow.
Two buttons offering typing or speaking.
A blurred curved band of colours used as decoration.
